d:
The 16th studio recorded single - Tu Keh De Toh, written, sung and composed by Anuv Jain is here!
Call Me Bae Season 2 stars Ananya Panday as Bae and features Vir Das, Gurfateh Pirzada, Varun Sood, Vihaan Samat, Muskkaan Jaferi, Niharika Lyra Dutt, Lisa Mishra, and Shruti Hassan in pivotal roles. A Dharmatic Entertainment production with Karan Johar, Apoorva Mehta, and Somen Mishra as executive producers, Call Me Bae has been created by Ishita Moitra and directed by Collin D'Cunha.
